class: Nested model attempts multiply request timeouts without useful progress evidence
symptom: The Fal correction took about 166 seconds, then produced a PDF and reached resume upload. It was mistakenly reported as stalled before the complete log was inspected.
root_cause: A document call traverses the page model ladder with a full socket timeout per model and can sleep on rate limits. Failed model attempts lacked start/end timing. The historical log cannot distinguish individual model attempts from a long active request.
why_tests_missed: Transport tests checked individual requests and quota fallback but not an elapsed budget shared across document model attempts.
fix: Share the configured timeout budget across Gemini document model attempts, reject responses arriving after the budget, skip rate-limit sleeps for documents, and log attempt start/end timings. This cooperative budget does not forcibly cancel an active Requests call.
prevention: Measure nested retries as one operation, report each attempt, and distinguish a socket inactivity timeout from a hard wall-clock deadline.
